messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High p99 latency on dedicated-eu-04 serving northstar-finance (>1200ms). Trigger: latency_threshold_p99. Link: https://redwood.ops/alerts/ALRT-9823 :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): saw it, taking initial ack. paging oncall-sre and eng-ml. @drew @ashok can you grab logs?

ashok (engineer): ack. pulling RT logs for model shard 3. looks like KV cache eviction spikes starting ~04:12 UTC. running quick query:

ashok (engineer): ```bash
# check eviction rate
rdwctl metrics get --cluster dedicated-eu-04 --metric cache_evictions_1m
```

ashok (engineer): eviction rate jumped x8, memory pressure on node-gpu-12. suspect OOM-swap-ish behavior after scheduled quantization job last night.

maria (oncall): good catch. are we seeing errors or just latency?

ashok (engineer): 500s minimal, mostly 200s with huge tail. sample request traces show long KV fetch times.

ops-bot: NOTE: Autoscaler will not spin additional nodes for dedicated clusters under reserved capacity limits without manual override. See policy #DC-Reserve.

maria (oncall): ok plan: 1) temporarily route northstar traffic to dedicated-eu-02 (compatible model variant), 2) clear KV cache on node-gpu-12, 3) scale up if needed. need approvals from eng-sre for cross-cluster routing. @drew?

elaine (cs): heads up — NorthStar Finance on enterprise dedicated. Their SLO is strict; they'll want a proactive notification. I can draft their message if you confirm impact window and mitigation plan.

raj (account exec): pls include account contacts: primary: jane.li@northstar.com, pager: +44 7700 900111. CC: tom.hu@northstar.com. They prefer email + slack DM for notices.

maria (oncall): @drew please run the routing override (manual) and watch for errors. ashok, hold off on reboot until we confirm graceful cache-clear won't regress.

ashok (engineer): starting cache-clear on node-gpu-12 (graceful). command:

ashok (engineer): ```bash
rdwctl cache clear --node node-gpu-12 --timeout 300 --graceful
```

ashok (engineer): cache-clear returned OK, eviction rate falling. p99 dropped from 1.3s -> 540ms in 2min. continuing to monitor.

maria (oncall): proceed with routing override to shift 30% traffic to dedicated-eu-02 for next 10m as canary.

ops-bot: ACTION: routing-override created by maria. ID rost-4782. From dedicated-eu-04 -> dedicated-eu-02 (30%) auto-fallback in 15m.

ashok (engineer): metrics look steady. p99 now ~320ms overall. no 500s observed since clear.

maria (oncall): cool. drafting status page + customer note. putting proposed text below — pls review and edit.

maria (oncall): STATUS PAGE DRAFT:

maria (oncall): "We are experiencing elevated response latencies for Redwood Dedicated cluster dedicated-eu-04 affecting a subset of enterprise customers. Impact: increased p99 latency up to ~1.2s for inference requests served from dedicated-eu-04 between 04:10–04:20 UTC. Mitigation: traffic has been partially routed to dedicated-eu-02 and a graceful KV cache clear was performed on node-gpu-12; end-to-end latency has improved and full remediation is in progress. No data loss has been detected. Ongoing monitoring; ETA for full recovery: 30 minutes."

drew (sre): Suggest we remove specific node id from public status page and say "a host in the cluster". Also change ETA to 45m to be conservative.

maria (oncall): updated: "a host in the cluster" and ETA 45 minutes.

elaine (cs): CUSTOMER EMAIL DRAFT for NorthStar Finance (please tailor):

elaine (cs): "Hi Jane,
We want to let you know about a short period of increased latency affecting inference calls for accounts served from our dedicated-eu-04 cluster between 04:10–04:20 UTC. Some requests experienced higher tail latency (p99 up to ~1.2s). We have routed a portion of traffic to a healthy cluster (dedicated-eu-02) and performed cache maintenance on the impacted host. Latency has returned to acceptable levels and we're monitoring. There was no impact to your data or request correctness. We expect to complete full verification by 05:05 UTC.
If you'd like, we can schedule a short post-incident call to review impact and steps we took.
Apologies for the disruption — Elaine (Customer Success) on behalf of Redwood Inference"

raj (account exec): looks good. add line about point of contact: "If you need immediate assistance, reply to this email or contact me directly at raj@redwood.com / +1 415 555 0199."

maria (oncall): internal comms note for SRE/ENG: quick checklist for postmortem:
- capture heap/kv metrics from 03:50–04:30 UTC
- verify quantization job from last night (who ran it?)
- confirm autoscaler behavior and reserved capacity thresholds
- determine if routing fallback should be automated for similar events

drew (sre): I'll own autoscaler probe + policy review. ashok pls save core logs and attach to incident channel after this thread.

ashok (engineer): saved logs to s3://redwood-incidents/ALRT-9823/ and uploaded trace snippets.

maria (oncall): routing traffic back to normal now (removing override).

ops-bot: ACTION: routing-override rost-4782 reverted by maria.

maria (oncall): marking this incident as "mitigated" in the tracker — will open a follow-up P1 postmortem ticket. tagging @drew to confirm final RFO.

drew (sre): RFO preliminary: unexpected KV cache growth after nightly quantization job caused host memory pressure and cache evictions producing long tail latency. working on durable fix (preventive memory cap + alert tuning).

elaine (cs): sending the customer email now and posting status page update. I'll follow up with Jane via DM as requested.

raj (account exec): I called Jane, left a note; she wants the postmortem once ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:

maria (oncall): handing over to post-incident owner for follow-up: @drew (owner). On-call moving to next rotation.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: ALRT-9823 status -> mitigated. Timeline and artifacts: https://redwood.ops/incidents/ALRT-9823

maria (oncall): closing thread from oncall perspective. great collaboration.
